title: Strict promo-funding balance-delta equality reverts on fee-on-transfer/rebasing promo token
description: Both owner-only promo-funding paths assert the received balance delta equals amount exactly (balanceOf(after)-balanceBefore == amount, L352/L380). For a fee-on-transfer/rebasing/donated token the delta differs and the strict-equality assertion reverts; funding is rejected (retryable, no funds lost).
impact: No theft, no fund loss. Owner-invoked, owner-vetted token, retryable revert.

suppression.reason: C4 known-invalid: owner-vetted fee-on-transfer / non-standard-ERC20 promo token, obvious+retryable harm, no fund risk.
suppression.qaTreatment: Removed from the QA Low findings set; retained only as a one-line informational QA note in qa-report.md.

recommendation: If fee-on-transfer/rebasing promo tokens are intended unsupported, document the strict-equality as a deliberate guard; otherwise record the actual received delta as the credited amount.
